reportSubtitle: Best CPL Week, Lookalike Audience Ready, Campaign Restructure
summary:
Best week of the campaign so far — 6 leads at ~$55 CPL across all three ad sets. That's nearly half the cost per lead of our best previous week ($90). Video bounced back to match Static after refined targeting, and AU/DE/FR got its first lead at ~$55.

On the funnel side, B2C interest is at an all-time high (21 plan signup clicks, up from 16 last week). Still waiting on GTM access to see if those signup clicks are converting.

Anna provided a 1,395-contact LinkedIn audience (studio professionals), which I've formatted and filtered to 1,228 contacts in our target countries. Combined with her request to narrow age to 32-48 and drop Germany/France, we're restructuring to four ad sets: interest and lookalike audiences, each with static and video creative, at $12.50/day each.

metrics.note: Down from $336 last week at nearly double the leads.

metrics.note: Best week since launch. All three ad sets contributing.

charts.title: Plan Signup Clicks by Tier (30-Day)
charts.note: 67% of self-serve interest is on the free tier. 22 paid-tier clicks = $994/mo revenue ceiling if all converted.

findings.title: All Three Ad Sets Converged Around $55 CPL
findings.description: Static ($55.75), Video ($55.10), and AU/DE/FR ($55.12) all delivered leads at nearly the same cost this week. This is a significant shift from last week when Video produced zero leads and the week before when Static was 2.4x more efficient.

findings.title: B2C Interest remains high, Demo Interest remains low
findings.description: Plan signup clicks hit 21 (up from 16), while cal_modal_opened dropped to 12 (from 29). 'View Pricing' button clicks surged to 47 (from 29). 'Book a Demo' clicks fell to 7 (from 18). Visitors are increasingly exploring pricing and self-serve tiers rather than the enterprise demo path.

findings.title: Lead Quality Is the Bottleneck, Not Volume
findings.description: CRM notes show most demos are B2C individual creators, low-budget prospects, or single-person operations. At $55 CPL the volume is there, but converting to enterprise revenue requires reaching higher-quality prospects — which the new lookalike audience is designed to address.

actions.title: Formatted 1,228-Contact LinkedIn Audience for Meta Upload
actions.description: Processed Anna's 1,395 LinkedIn contacts (studio professionals, 10+ employees). Filtered to US/UK/CA/AU, mapped to Meta's CSV template with email, name, location, zip, and company size as value signal.

actions.title: Campaign Restructure to 4 Ad Sets
actions.description: New structure: Interest Static, Interest Video, Lookalike Static, Lookalike Video — $12.50/day each. Retiring AU/DE/FR ad set, folding AU into primary geos. Age narrowed to 32-48 per Anna.

nextSteps: Monitor first week of restructured campaign closely — age narrowing may temporarily affect CPL
Follow up on GTM access for finalbitai.com to close the signup attribution loop
Check Pipedrive in 2 weeks to compare lead quality between interest and lookalike audiences
